newsitem.title: USA: Food Lion sees deal immediately accretive.
newsitem.headline: Food Lion sees deal immediately accretive.

text.p: Food Lion Inc said on Thursday that it sees its pending acquisition of Kash n' Karry Food Stores Inc immediately accretive to earnings on financing alone.

In a telephone conference call, company executives said that Kash n' Karry's earnings before interest and taxes last year was $31.8 million, or $12.6 million higher than the cost that Food Lion will incur to finance the deal.

Food Lion said it plans to redeem up to $204 million of Kash n' Karry's debt and that the additional cost of capital it would incur to pay off the debt would be $9 to $10 million less that Kash n' Karry's cost of capital.
Food Lion said it plans to redeem the debt about a month after the acquisition is completed.
